alex: quick postmortem follow-up: we keep seeing repeated large blast radii from fast feature-flag ramps. proposing a compact sprint to harden rollouts. owners?

alex: proposed sprint (minimal):
- pre-ramp probe (1% x 5m) wired into CI
- flag metadata + naming (rollback_safe, max_pct, owner)
- auto-rollback enabled only when rollback_safe=auto
- audit events for any automated action
- runbook + Console 'quarantine' button for fast containment

brenda: I can own metadata + naming conv. ETA 5d. will add examples and migration notes.

carlos: I'll own pre-ramp probe + CI gate. plan: 1% x5m, compare to rolling 30m baseline; fallback to 24h EWMA for low-signal. fail -> hold and page. ETA 7d.

alex: brenda please set default max_pct=5% for prod and include rollback_safe enum (auto/manual/forbidden). carlos ensure probe emits activation histogram to telemetry.

brenda: noted  adding rollback_safe enum and owner contact field in templates. will include a script to migrate existing flags.

devops-bot: Created ticket INF-7007 -> "Pre-ramp probe & CI gate" (assignee: carlos, due: 7d).
devops-bot: Created ticket INF-7008 -> "Flag metadata + naming conv" (assignee: brenda, due: 5d).
devops-bot: Created ticket INF-7009 -> "Runbook + quarantine button" (assignee: alex, due: 8d).

alex: next steps: owners update tickets with PR list, blockers, and minimal test plan by EOD Tue. quick sync Wed 09:00 in #eng-platform to triage blockers. goal: default fewer blast incidents next quarter.

carlos: pinging infra for probe quota approvals now.

brenda: will post the naming doc draft and template PR today.
